title: 两万步

lines.py: yuán lái, Jié kè měi tiān zhōng wǔ dōu lái zhè r chī fàn, yì lái jiù bǎ shǒu jī jiāo gěi Xiǎo Zhōu, wǎn shang zài lái ná. Xiǎo Zhōu cóng zhōng wǔ máng dào wǎn shang, zài fàn guǎn lǐ zǒu lái zǒu qù, shǎo shuō yě yào zǒu yí wàn wǔ qiān bù.
lines.en: It turns out that Jack eats here every lunchtime. As soon as he arrives, he hands his phone to Xiao Zhou, and he picks it up again in the evening. Busy from noon till evening, rushing back and forth in the restaurant, Xiao Zhou does at least fifteen thousand steps.

tr.fa: همون عصر، بعد از اردک، جک می‌خواد تاکسی بگیره بره خونه، ولی وانگ مینگ جلوش رو می‌گیره: «اصلاً! امروز خودت پیاده برو خونه.»
